title: NEGATIVE TEST ONLY: poll response carries an unexpected token-shaped field -- prove the parser drops it
notes: The REAL cc auth verb never emits a token to the app (invariant #6) -- this fixture does not model a real CLI response, it is a deliberately poisoned NEGATIVE-TEST input for fitness fn 2 (no-secret-on-wizard-DTO, .copilot/wp/15.md §4). Feed this scenario's poll body through the Rust parser (S3 sec-owned) and assert the resulting WizardState/DTO contains no 'access_token' field and the literal string 'FAKE-SYNTHETIC-NOT-A-REAL-TOKEN-0000000000' does not appear anywhere the app could render or log it. The field name (access_token) and value are both obviously synthetic and never reused by any non-adversarial scenario in this corpus.
